segments.ja306:1.3: Upalohitakā vaggū, taṃ [te (pī.)] me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja306:2.1: Yāni pure tuvaṃ devi, bhaṇḍu nantakavāsinī;
segments.ja306:2.3: Ucchaṅgahatthā pacināsi, tassā te koliyaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.ja306:3.1: Uḍḍayhate na ramati, bhogā vippajahanti taṃ [vippajahanti’ maṃ (?)];
segments.ja306:4.3: Khama deva sujātāya, māssā [māsu (ka.)] kujjha rathesabhāti.
